maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is lease-to-own rentals of furniture, appliances and electronics through Acima and Rent-A-Center, which are first-time customer acquisitions, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers making lease-to-own payments, plus fees from retailers and app users, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from Acima and Rent-A-Center lease volume; Acima and Brigit were only occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other lease-to-own or credit options; retailers can add other providers at point of sale.
